layout: Every effect sheet is 2 columns by 2 rows. Four animation frames in reading order. Original generated PNGs copied unchanged; alpha retained.

assets.name: slash-sheet.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent pixel-art animated spell-effect sprite sheet for an original 16-bit classroom JRPG.
Primary request: A sword slash impact: a bright ivory and warm gold curved crescent cuts diagonally across the cell from upper left to lower right, with small silver pixel sparks. Four sequential frames: narrow forming arc, full broad crescent slash, separated trailing crescents, fading small sparks. No sword, no character.
Composition: EXACTLY FOUR sequential frames arranged as a strict 2 COLUMN by 2 ROW grid on a square 1024x1024 transparent canvas. Each cell is 512x512. Reading order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. All effects centered at EXACTLY the same coordinates relative to their own cell, equal scale. Entire effect stays inside its cell with at least 12 percent empty transparent margins. No crossing cell boundaries. No grid lines, no labels, no text. Genuinely transparent RGBA background, preserve alpha, not a checkerboard picture.
Style: true crisp 16-bit pixel-art, chunky square pixel clusters, limited palette, dark subtle pixel outlines only if needed, readable at 80x80 pixels, no smooth photographic blur. All four frames should visibly progress as a usable animation. Original art. No UI, no frame, no watermark, no lettering.
